name: Whisperio – AI Dictation
subtitle: Voice Typing with Your AI Key
promotionalText: Dictation for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. On-device by default, or bring your own AI key. No account, no subscription, no Whisperio server.
description:
Whisperio turns your voice into clean, formatted text, anywhere you type on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.

No account. No subscription. No Whisperio server. The app is free, and by default your speech is recognized on your device.

DICTATE ANYWHERE
Trigger dictation from the Home Screen widget, Control Center, Back Tap, Apple Watch or the system-wide Whisperio keyboard. Text appears where you're already typing: Messages, Notes, Slack, email, anywhere.

ON-DEVICE BY DEFAULT
Out of the box, Whisperio uses Apple's speech recognition on your device. Apple's servers are used only if you allow online recognition in Settings or your language is not available on-device. You can also download a local model and keep transcription on your device.

YOUR PROVIDERS, YOUR KEYS
Want a cloud engine? Bring your own API key for OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Groq, Mistral or Replicate, or point Whisperio at your own OpenAI-compatible server. No markup on API usage: you pay the provider directly and see exactly what it costs. Keys stay in your device's Keychain and are sent only to their own provider.

AI CLEANUP, ON YOUR TERMS
Raw dictation pastes instantly. When you want it polished, run on-demand AI cleanup: fix grammar, apply a custom instruction or use a saved template, without waiting on every word.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Whisperio never phones home to a Whisperio server and has no analytics or tracking. Audio goes straight from your device to the transcription provider you chose, or nowhere at all when you transcribe on-device. Cloud providers process your audio under their own terms, so pick the one you trust.

STAYS IN SYNC
Your dictation history syncs across iPhone, iPad and Mac through your private iCloud database (transcripts and metadata, no audio), or stays on this device only if you prefer. It is organized into a searchable journal with categories (Work, Personal, Ideas, Messages, Code, To-do) and an optional AI daily digest.

BUILT FOR SPEED
- System-wide custom keyboard with predictive suggestions
- Home Screen widget and Apple Watch trigger
- Personal dictionary and vocabulary
- Group conversation mode with speaker labels
- Native Mac app with global hotkeys

Whisperio is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so you can inspect exactly how it handles your voice and your keys.

Privacy Policy: https://whisperio.danielkasprzyk.com/privacy.html
